task: image-level binary classification: source-labeled bad/very_bad versus other quality labels

training.early_stopping: stopped after 7 epochs based on validation F1

limits: This classifies whole images by perceived surface quality; it does not detect or localize individual hazards.
The held-out paving_stones group contained zero bad/very_bad examples, so performance on damaged pavers was not measured.
Overall metrics are dominated by surface categories and do not establish safe mobility warnings.
Imagery is mostly from Germany; no South African local validation was performed.
The trained classifier was not integrated into the live PathSignal alert app.
ONNX export was blocked in Kaggle because onnxscript is missing; trained checkpoint remains in the Kaggle run output.
